clauses.SA-JUR-2026-J.1: In Colombia, every vehicle on a public road must carry the SOAT. The civil liability insurance of this policy is voluntary and adds to the SOAT. Seguros Aburrá does not issue it with limits below these minimums: COP 25,000,000 for the death or injury of one person, COP 50,000,000 for all victims of one accident and COP 20,000,000 for third-party property damage.
clauses.SA-JUR-2026-J.2: An insurer that decides to revoke a policy must notify the policyholder in writing at least ten days in advance and refund the unearned premium (Commercial Code, art. 1071). If the premium is not paid, the contract ends automatically (Commercial Code, art. 1068).
clauses.SA-JUR-2026-J.3: Anyone who suffers a loss event must report it to their insurer within three business days of learning about it. The parties may extend that period but not shorten it (Commercial Code, arts. 1075 and 829).
clauses.SA-JUR-2026-J.4: Drivers must have a current SOAT, which traffic authorities check in the national registry. The law does not require the voluntary insurance of this policy to drive.
clauses.SA-JUR-2026-J.5: Actions arising from the insurance contract expire two years after the interested party learned, or should have learned, of the event that gives rise to them, and in any case five years after the right arises (Commercial Code, art. 1081).
clauses.SA-PAP-2025-A.EXCL.A.5.ALT: We do not cover liability that arises while the vehicle is carrying people or goods, whether for pay or not, including trips where acquaintances share the costs.
clauses.SA-PAP-2025-A.INS: Seguros Aburrá pays the damages you cause to third parties with the insured vehicle, up to the limit of this section, but does not take on your defense: lawyers' fees are at your expense.
clauses.SA-PAP-2025-C.INS.ALT: Seguros Aburrá pays the personal accident insured value if the authorized driver dies or is left with a total permanent disability because of a traffic accident. Partial permanent disability is not covered.
clauses.SA-PAP-2025-D.INS.COLLISION.ALT: Seguros Aburrá pays the direct damage suffered by the insured vehicle from a crash or rollover, minus the partial-loss-by-damage deductible, only if someone else caused the crash.
clauses.SA-PAP-2025-D.TRANSPORT: If your insured vehicle suffers a total loss by damage or theft, we reimburse the transportation expenses up to COP 30,000 a day and COP 900,000 in total, starting on the third day.
clauses.SA-PAP-2025-DEF.COVERED_AUTO: "Insured vehicle" means the car listed on the declarations page. A vehicle bought during the policy period is only insured from the moment it is added to the declarations page by endorsement.
clauses.SA-PAP-2025-DEF.YOU.ALT: "You" means only the policyholder listed as the insured on the declarations page; a spouse or permanent partner is not included even when living with that person.
clauses.SA-PAP-2025-E.DUTIES.A.1.ALT: Tell us about any loss event within thirty days; after that, the notice is no longer accepted.
clauses.SA-PAP-2026-A.EXCL.A.1: This section does not cover harm that you or an authorized driver cause on purpose, or harm someone else causes following your instructions.
clauses.SA-PAP-2026-A.EXCL.A.2: This section does not cover damage to things you own or are carrying in the vehicle.
clauses.SA-PAP-2026-A.EXCL.A.3: This section does not cover damage to things you have rented, borrowed or are looking after for someone else.
clauses.SA-PAP-2026-A.EXCL.A.4: This section does not cover injuries to your own employees that happen while they are working; those are handled by the labor and occupational risk systems.
clauses.SA-PAP-2026-A.EXCL.A.5: This section does not cover accidents that happen while the vehicle provides public transport service or carries people or goods for pay, including trips booked through a ride app. Friends splitting the cost of a trip is not considered pay.
clauses.SA-PAP-2026-A.EXCL.A.6: This section does not cover liability that arises while the vehicle is used in a business that sells, repairs, washes, parks or stores vehicles.
clauses.SA-PAP-2026-A.EXCL.A.7: This section does not cover anyone driving a vehicle without the owner's permission or without a sound reason to believe they had it.
clauses.SA-PAP-2026-A.EXCL.A.8: This section does not cover accidents during races, speed contests or performance tests, or while practicing for them.
clauses.SA-PAP-2026-A.EXCL.A.9: This section does not pay fines, traffic tickets, penalties or damages that a court imposes to punish rather than to repair harm.
clauses.SA-PAP-2026-A.EXCL.B.1: This section does not cover driving a motorcycle, a motorized three-wheeler or any other two- or three-wheeled vehicle.
clauses.SA-PAP-2026-A.EXCL.B.2: This section does not cover using a vehicle you own that is not listed on the declarations page, except a newly bought vehicle that the insured vehicle definition includes.
clauses.SA-PAP-2026-A.EXCL.B.3: This section does not cover using a vehicle that a family member owns, or that a family member has on hand for regular use, unless that vehicle is listed on the declarations page.
clauses.SA-PAP-2026-A.INS: If you or an authorized driver cause, with the insured vehicle or with a replacement vehicle, a traffic accident for which they must answer to a third party under the law, Seguros Aburrá pays the damages for property damage, for death or injury to one person and for death or injury to two or more people. We pay up to the limits of this section and in excess of what the SOAT covers. An authorized driver is someone who drives with your permission and a valid driver's license. We also handle the defense against those claims, with lawyers we choose, and we may settle with the victim whenever we think it wise. Our defense duty stops once our payments reach the limit.
clauses.SA-PAP-2026-A.LIMIT: The declarations page sets three limits. The limit for death or injury to one person is the most we pay for each victim in one accident. The limit for death or injury to two or more people is the most for all victims of that accident. The property damage limit is the most for all third-party property damaged. Adding insureds, vehicles or claims does not raise these limits.
clauses.SA-PAP-2026-A.OTHER: If another liability policy also responds to the accident, we split the payment in proportion to each policy's limits. For a vehicle you do not own, that vehicle's own insurance pays first and we pay what remains.
clauses.SA-PAP-2026-A.OUT_OF_COUNTRY: When a territory endorsement extends the policy to another country and the law there requires compulsory insurance to drive, that insurance pays first and this section pays the excess, up to the limit on the declarations page. We never pay twice for the same loss.
clauses.SA-PAP-2026-A.SOAT: This section does not replace the SOAT, which the law requires of every vehicle on the road. What the SOAT covers responds first, and this policy pays the excess, with at least the minimum limits set in the "Legal framework" document.
clauses.SA-PAP-2026-A.SUPP: In addition to the limit of this section, and without reducing it, Seguros Aburrá pays the costs of the lawsuit that the victim files against you or against us over a covered accident (Commercial Code, art. 1128), any court bond needed, and your reasonable out-of-pocket costs when we ask for help with the case, including travel to hearings. We do not pay them if the accident was caused on purpose or is excluded, or if you face the lawsuit against our written instruction.
clauses.SA-PAP-2026-AGREEMENT.1: The purpose of this insurance is to cover the coverages that the declarations page shows as contracted: civil liability to third parties, loss of the vehicle by damage or theft, medical expenses of the occupants and personal accident cover for the driver. Seguros Aburrá pays them on the terms of this contract, for loss events that happen within the territory set out in the general conditions. A loss event is the occurrence that causes the damage or the loss. This insurance is voluntary and does not replace the SOAT.
clauses.SA-PAP-2026-AGREEMENT.2: Coverage runs for the policy period shown on the declarations page, as long as the premium is paid. Keeping it in force depends on the policyholder meeting the duties this contract assigns, especially those in the section "Duties after a loss event".
clauses.SA-PAP-2026-B.EXCL.1: This section does not pay for injuries suffered on a motorcycle or any other two- or three-wheeled vehicle.
clauses.SA-PAP-2026-B.EXCL.2: This section does not pay for injuries suffered while the vehicle provides public transport service or carries passengers for pay.
clauses.SA-PAP-2026-B.EXCL.3: This section does not pay for injuries that happen while the vehicle is being used as a home or as a fixed workplace.
clauses.SA-PAP-2026-B.EXCL.4: This section does not pay for injuries suffered in races, speed contests or performance tests.
clauses.SA-PAP-2026-B.INS: If you, the authorized driver or another occupant of the insured vehicle is injured in a traffic accident, Seguros Aburrá pays their reasonable medical, hospital and funeral expenses, in excess of what the SOAT covers. The expenses must arise within two years of the accident.
clauses.SA-PAP-2026-B.LIMIT: The per-person limit on the declarations page is the most we pay toward each injured occupant's medical costs from one accident, however many people or vehicles are involved.
clauses.SA-PAP-2026-B.OTHER: If the SOAT or another medical expenses policy covers the same costs, we pay only what is left unpaid after it, up to our limit.
clauses.SA-PAP-2026-C.ARBITRATION: If we disagree with you or the beneficiaries about whether a payment is owed, about the degree of disability or about the amount, either side may ask for the question to be decided by a single arbitrator in Colombia. Each side pays its own costs and half of the arbitrator's fee.
clauses.SA-PAP-2026-C.EXCL.1: This section does not cover an accident of the driver while driving a vehicle that is not the insured vehicle.
clauses.SA-PAP-2026-C.EXCL.2: This section does not cover death or disability that the driver causes to themselves on purpose.
clauses.SA-PAP-2026-C.EXCL.3: This section does not apply while the vehicle provides public transport service or carries people or goods for pay.
clauses.SA-PAP-2026-C.EXCL.4: This section does not cover anyone driving the vehicle without the owner's permission or without a sound reason to believe they had it.
clauses.SA-PAP-2026-C.INS: If the authorized driver of the insured vehicle dies, or is left with a permanent disability, because of a traffic accident that happens while driving, Seguros Aburrá pays the personal accident insured value shown on the declarations page. For a permanent disability we pay according to the percentage of lost capacity determined by the competent authority. If the driver dies, we pay the driver's beneficiaries.
clauses.SA-PAP-2026-C.LIMIT: The most we pay under this section is the personal accident insured value shown on the declarations page, once per accident, however many vehicles or people are involved. What the at-fault party pays the victim is not subtracted.
clauses.SA-PAP-2026-C.OTHER: If the driver has other personal accident insurance, each policy pays its own insured value: what the others pay does not reduce what we pay.
clauses.SA-PAP-2026-D.APPRAISAL: If we and you disagree on the amount of a loss, each side names an appraiser and the two appraisers choose a third. What any two of the three agree on binds both sides. Each side pays its own appraiser and half of the third.
clauses.SA-PAP-2026-D.EXCL.1: This section does not cover damage that happens while the vehicle provides public transport service or carries people or goods for pay.
clauses.SA-PAP-2026-D.EXCL.10: This section does not cover damage that you or a family member cause to the vehicle on purpose.
clauses.SA-PAP-2026-D.EXCL.11: This section does not cover damage caused by loading the vehicle beyond the weight its manufacturer allows.
clauses.SA-PAP-2026-D.EXCL.12: This section does not cover theft when the vehicle was left unlocked with the keys inside or with the engine running in a public place.
clauses.SA-PAP-2026-D.EXCL.13: This section does not cover flood damage when the driver entered a road that authorities had closed or marked as flooded.
clauses.SA-PAP-2026-D.EXCL.2: This section does not cover wear from use, rust, lack of maintenance, or mechanical or electrical failure, unless it results from a theft or another covered loss.
clauses.SA-PAP-2026-D.EXCL.3: This section does not cover sound systems, screens, navigation units or other electronics that were not installed at the factory.
clauses.SA-PAP-2026-D.EXCL.4: This section does not cover personal belongings inside the vehicle, such as clothing, tools, cash or phones.
clauses.SA-PAP-2026-D.EXCL.5: This section does not cover damage limited to the tires, such as flats or blowouts, unless it comes from fire, theft or vandalism.
clauses.SA-PAP-2026-D.EXCL.6: This section does not cover losing the vehicle to seizure, impoundment or destruction ordered by an authority.
clauses.SA-PAP-2026-D.EXCL.7: This section does not cover damage caused by war, rebellion, organized terrorism or nuclear energy.
clauses.SA-PAP-2026-D.EXCL.8: This section does not cover damage suffered in races, speed contests or performance tests, or while practicing for them.
clauses.SA-PAP-2026-D.EXCL.9: This section does not cover parts, accessories or modifications added to the vehicle without telling us, such as custom wheels, altered suspension or engine upgrades.
clauses.SA-PAP-2026-D.INS.COLLISION: If you collide with another vehicle or an object, or if the insured vehicle rolls over, Seguros Aburrá pays for the damage to the vehicle, even if you caused the crash. It also pays for damage from fire, flood, hail, falling objects, vandalism, broken glass or hitting an animal. In a partial loss, you pay the partial-loss-by-damage deductible on the declarations page: the deductible is the share of the loss that you bear.
clauses.SA-PAP-2026-D.INS.THEFT: We also pay for theft of the insured vehicle, minus the partial-loss-by-theft deductible on the declarations page. It is a total loss by theft if the vehicle disappears and does not turn up after the report, and a partial loss by theft if parts or accessories are stolen.
clauses.SA-PAP-2026-D.LIMIT: The most we pay for a loss event is the insured value, which is the vehicle's commercial value in the Fasecolda Value Guide on the date of the loss event. If repairing the vehicle costs 75% or more of that value, it is a total loss. If it costs less, it is a partial loss and we pay the repair or the replacement of the parts with equivalent ones.
clauses.SA-PAP-2026-D.NO_BAILEE: This coverage does not benefit anyone who has the vehicle in their care as a business, such as a repair shop, a parking garage or a car transport company; if they caused the damage, we may recover it from them.
clauses.SA-PAP-2026-D.OTHER_SOURCES: If another policy or source covers the same loss, we pay only our share, in proportion to our limit against the total.
clauses.SA-PAP-2026-D.PAYMENT: We choose whether to pay the loss in cash or to arrange the repair or replacement ourselves. We pay within one month of the day you prove the loss event and its amount (Commercial Code, art. 1080). If the loss is total, the vehicle or what remains of it, which is the salvage, becomes ours and you sign the transfer. If a stolen vehicle turns up before we pay, we give it back to you and pay for any damage it suffered.
clauses.SA-PAP-2026-D.TRANSPORT: If your insured vehicle suffers a total loss by damage or theft, we reimburse the transportation expenses you pay in the meantime, up to COP 50,000 a day and COP 1,500,000 in total, which is 30 days. Reimbursement counts from the day after the loss event.
clauses.SA-PAP-2026-DEF.BODILY_INJURY: "Personal injury" means any harm to a person's health caused by the accident, including wounds, illness that follows from them and, when it happens, death.
clauses.SA-PAP-2026-DEF.COMMERCIAL_VALUE: "Commercial value" means what your insured vehicle is worth on the market on the day of the loss event, according to the Fasecolda Value Guide. The guide is read with the vehicle's code and model year. The commercial value is the basis of the insured value.
clauses.SA-PAP-2026-DEF.COVERED_AUTO: "Insured vehicle" means the private passenger car listed on the declarations page. A vehicle you buy during the policy period is also an insured vehicle if you tell us about it within ten days of taking delivery.
clauses.SA-PAP-2026-DEF.FAMILY_MEMBER: "Family member" means someone who lives in your home and is related to you by birth, marriage, permanent partnership or adoption, including children in your legal care.
clauses.SA-PAP-2026-DEF.OCCUPYING: "Occupant" means someone inside a vehicle, climbing in or out of it, or standing next to it while loading it or pushing it by hand.
clauses.SA-PAP-2026-DEF.PROPERTY_DAMAGE: "Property damage" means breaking, destroying or making unusable a physical object that belongs to a third party, such as another car, a fence or a storefront. A third party is anyone other than you, your spouse or permanent partner, and whoever drives with your permission.
clauses.SA-PAP-2026-DEF.TEMPORARY_SUBSTITUTE: "Replacement vehicle" means the one you drive temporarily, without owning it, while your insured vehicle is out of service because of repair, breakdown, theft or total loss. For as long as that situation lasts, it receives the same protection as the insured vehicle.
clauses.SA-PAP-2026-DEF.WE: "We" means Seguros Aburrá, the insurer that issues this policy and stands behind it.
clauses.SA-PAP-2026-DEF.YOU: "You" means the policyholder, the person who bought the insurance and is listed as the insured on the declarations page. It also includes that person's spouse or permanent partner while the two live with you. The beneficiary of the payment for damage to the vehicle is you, unless the declarations page names someone else, such as a bank holding a pledge on the vehicle.
clauses.SA-PAP-2026-E.DUTIES.A.1: Tell us about the loss event within three business days of learning about it, as the legal framework sets (Commercial Code, art. 1075).
clauses.SA-PAP-2026-E.DUTIES.A.2: Tell us how, when and where it happened, and which vehicles and people were involved.
clauses.SA-PAP-2026-E.DUTIES.A.3: Give us the name and a way to reach any injured person and any witness you know of.
clauses.SA-PAP-2026-E.DUTIES.B.1: Work with us as we look into the claim and as we defend any claim made against you.
clauses.SA-PAP-2026-E.DUTIES.B.2: Send us right away a copy of any notice, summons or lawsuit you receive about the loss event, including a summons to a conciliation hearing.
clauses.SA-PAP-2026-E.DUTIES.B.3: If the claim involves injuries, attend the medical exams we request, with doctors we pay for, as often as is reasonable.
clauses.SA-PAP-2026-E.DUTIES.B.4: Give us the evidence that the loss event happened and what it cost (Commercial Code, art. 1077), a written account of the loss if we ask for one, and your authorization to obtain your medical records if there were injuries.
clauses.SA-PAP-2026-E.DUTIES.C.1: If the accident leaves injured or dead people, or the vehicle at fault drove off without being identified, tell the traffic authority within 24 hours and ask for the accident report.
clauses.SA-PAP-2026-E.DUTIES.C.2: Do not admit liability, settle or pay anything to the third party without our written authorization.
clauses.SA-PAP-2026-E.DUTIES.D.1: Take reasonable steps to keep the vehicle from further damage (Commercial Code, art. 1074); we pay back what you spend doing so.
clauses.SA-PAP-2026-E.DUTIES.D.2: If the vehicle or any of its parts was stolen, report it to the competent authority immediately.
clauses.SA-PAP-2026-E.DUTIES.D.3: Let us see and appraise the vehicle before you repair it or get rid of it.
clauses.SA-PAP-2026-END-1-DEF.FAMILY_MEMBER: For this policy, your son or daughter under 25 who studies in another city and lives there during the study period is also a family member, even if they do not live in your home.
clauses.SA-PAP-2026-END-2-A.EXCL.A.5: The exclusion for transport for pay does not apply while the insured vehicle provides service through a ride-hailing platform registered in Colombia, from the moment the driver accepts the trip until the passenger gets out. The same limits of the civil liability section apply.
clauses.SA-PAP-2026-END-3-D.EXCL.3: The exclusion for electronic equipment not installed at the factory does not apply to equipment you have declared with its invoice, up to COP 1,500,000 per loss and with the partial-loss-by-theft deductible.
clauses.SA-PAP-2026-END-4-C.ARBITRATION: Arbitration under the driver personal accident section is decided by a panel of three arbitrators: one named by each side and the third chosen by the first two. Each side pays its own arbitrator and half of the third.
clauses.SA-PAP-2026-END-5-F.PERIOD_TERRITORY: The policy's territory extends to trips of up to 30 consecutive days through the neighboring countries of Colombia, as long as the insured vehicle returns to Colombia at the end of the trip.
clauses.SA-PAP-2026-F.BANKRUPTCY: If you become insolvent, Seguros Aburrá still owes what this policy covers. For civil liability, the payment is for the victim (Commercial Code, art. 1127).
clauses.SA-PAP-2026-F.CHANGES: This contract changes only in writing, through an endorsement we issue. You tell us in writing about any change that alters the risk, such as a change in how the vehicle is used, and we adjust the premium from the date of the change. Notices are sent to the address or email you gave us.
clauses.SA-PAP-2026-F.FRAUD: You described the state of the risk when buying the policy, and you must have done so truthfully. We give no coverage to anyone who knowingly lied about or hid an important fact about the accident, the loss or the state of the risk; if the inaccuracy was in good faith, the payment may be reduced as the law provides (Commercial Code, art. 1058).
clauses.SA-PAP-2026-F.LEGAL_ACTION: The rights arising from this policy expire within the periods the law sets (Commercial Code, art. 1081), and no one may sue without first meeting the duties the policy sets.
clauses.SA-PAP-2026-F.PERIOD_TERRITORY: The policy covers loss events that happen during the policy period shown on the declarations page and within the territory of Colombia. There is no coverage outside Colombia unless a territory endorsement extends it to another country.
clauses.SA-PAP-2026-F.RECOVERY: When we pay for harm that someone else caused, we take your place to collect what we paid from that person, up to that amount (Commercial Code, art. 1096). You help us do so and do nothing to undermine it.
clauses.SA-PAP-2026-F.TERMINATION: You may revoke the policy at any time by telling us in writing. We may revoke it only with the advance notice the legal framework requires, and we refund the premium for the time that had not yet run. If the premium is not paid on time, the policy ends automatically (Commercial Code, art. 1068).
clauses.SA-PAP-2026-F.TRANSFER: If you sell the insured vehicle, or transfer your rights under this policy, the insurance does not pass to the buyer or to anyone else without our written consent.
clauses.SA-PAP-2026-F.TWO_POLICIES: If two or more insurances cover the same loss event, you must tell us about all of them. If they are Seguros Aburrá policies, the most we pay is the highest limit of any single one of them.
